v_sysdate date;

begin

 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;


/********************************************************************
Diptiia SCR 216 to handle mucltiple core conditions
********************************************************************/
/*****************************************************************/
/* SELECT DEFAULT ATTRIBUTE and ATTRIBUTE GROUP */

--Step 1: Get the Anticoagulant and Volume for the product type

BEGIN 

 -- time zone change --5/11/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;

 SELECT distinct vc.anticoagulant , vc.bag_volume 
 into szAnticoagulant, szBagVol
 FROM valid_catalogs vc, valid_lots vl, units u
 WHERE vc.catalog_number = vl.catalog_number
 AND vl.lot_number = u.lot_number
 AND u.catalog_number=vc.catalog_number
 AND vc.chapter_id=:global.chapter_id
 --AND vl.bag_code=u.bag_code
 AND u.unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 AND trunc(u.coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date)
 AND vl.chapter_id = u.chapter_id -- Added by Kishore on 03/18/2011. IM 5013
 AND u.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND v_sysdate between vl.eff_date and nvl(vl.term_date, to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'))
 AND v_sysdate between vc.eff_date and nvl(vc.term_date, to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'));
 Exception when others then 
 message('Could not get the Anticoagulant-'||sqlerrm);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 End;
 
 --Step 2: Get how many core conditions are there. (First check how many core conditions are found)
 -- message('Anti='||szAnticoagulant||' Bag vol='||to_char(szBagVol));pause;

 if szBagVol is null then --disregard volume
 select nvl(count(*),0) into sznCore from valid_product_type_attributes where 
 product_type = :ctrl_blk_2.product_type 
 and anticoagulant_code=szAnticoagulant
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1);
 else
 select nvl(count(*),0) into sznCore from valid_product_type_attributes where 
 product_type = :ctrl_blk_2.product_type 
 and anticoagulant_code=szAnticoagulant
 and volume = szBagVol 
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1);
 end if;
 
 IF sznCore = 0 then 
 show_error('9732');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF sznCore =1 then --for single core condition
 --message('single');
 POPULATE_PRODUCT_CODE(szAnticoagulant,szBagVol);
 check_package_failure; -- code from before
/******************************************************************
code from before change by diptiia
*******************************************************************/
/*
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.product_code'); 
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 check_package_failure; */

 
 ELSE --- sznCore > 1 If the combination has multiple core conditions
--message('multi') ;pause;
 POPULATE_MULTIPLE_CORE(szAnticoagulant,szBagVol);

END IF;


EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
END;
